title: Identify the top 5 best-selling products (by total quantity sold) purchased

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T3."XCL_009" FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1."XCL_013" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1."XCL_016" = T3."XCL_008"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T4 ON T1."XCL_015" = T4."XCL_004"
WHERE T2."XCL_003" = 'EUR' AND T4."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
GROUP BY T3."XCL_008"
ORDER BY SUM(T1."XCL_017") DESC
LIMIT 5
